## Captain America Vol 1 176



## Appearing in "Captain America Must Die!"

**Featured Characters:**

## Synopsis for "Captain America Must Die!"

Disgusted at corruption in our nation's government and after much thought and reflection, [Steve Rogers](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Steven_Rogers_(Earth-616) "Steven Rogers (Earth-616)") abandons his role as [Captain America](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Captain_America "Captain America").

Release Date: 1974
